items.title: MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation
items.summary_zh: MoFlow 根据实际执行的多目标反馈搜索多 Agent 工作流，修改算子、角色和分支循环，并保留候选前沿供后续偏好选择。开发与留出评测分开，在线搜索和离线复用的证据需要分别理解。
items.summary_en: MoFlow searches multi-agent workflows using multi-objective execution feedback, revising operators, roles and branching or loops while retaining a candidate frontier for later preference selection. Development and held-out evaluation are separated; online search and offline reuse provide distinct evidence.

items.title: CollabFlow: Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Collaboration
items.summary_zh: CollabFlow 一边训练协作规划器，一边依据团队执行结果增删改技能库，并将修订后的文本策略绑定到后续轮次的 Agent。两条更新链使其符合模型与外部 Harness 共演化。技能编辑分析聚焦于增益最大的步骤，且规划器同步训练，因此不能据此把收益单独归因于技能修改。
items.summary_en: CollabFlow trains a collaboration director while adding, modifying, and removing library skills in response to team execution outcomes. Revised textual strategies are bound to agents in later evolution steps, supporting a model-and-Harness coevolution classification. Its skill-edit analysis selects the steps with the largest gains while the director also changes, so the observed gains cannot be attributed to skill edits alone.

items.title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
items.short_title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations
items.summary_zh: 本文研究自修改软件 Agent 在替换、分叉和回滚时的授权继承，并用真实框架适配器检查变异后的权限约束。它属于 Harness 演化安全理论；适配器验证不等于自主开放式进化，本次也未复核形式证明。
items.summary_en: This work studies authorization inheritance when self-modifying software agents replace, fork or roll back, with framework adapters checking authority after mutations. It concerns Harness-evolution safety theory; adapter validation is not autonomous open-ended evolution, and this review does not recertify the formal proofs.

items.title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
items.short_title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 研究将专家对验证失败的诊断沉淀为版本化的程序指导、技能与工具接口，并比较这些资源对编码 Agent 验证行为的影响。可作为 Harness 专项评测收录；资源由专家维护，受控对照的效应区间跨零，既不证明自主 Harness 演化，也未确认普遍收益或独立留出集迁移。
items.summary_en: This study turns expert diagnoses of verification failures into versioned procedural guidance, skills, and tool interfaces, and evaluates how these resources affect coding-agent verification. It supports a Harness-specific evaluation classification. The resources are expert maintained and the controlled effect intervals span zero; the study does not establish autonomous Harness evolution, a general benefit, or transfer to an independently held-out task family.

items.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary_zh: InterEvolve 根据仿真执行反馈修改分阶段奖励程序、转移条件和常数，用它们在推理时驱动冻结的控制器，并将选中的程序与验证记录保留在技能库中供后续任务组合和修改。它符合 Harness 组件演化；模型冻结限于演化阶段，实机展示沿用仿真中生成的程序，未证明物理环境中的在线自主演化。
items.summary_en: InterEvolve revises staged reward programs, transition conditions, and constants using simulation feedback. These programs drive a frozen controller at inference, and selected programs with verifier records enter a skill library for later composition and adaptation. This supports Harness-component evolution. Freezing applies to the evolution phase, and physical demonstrations reuse simulation-evolved programs rather than establishing autonomous online evolution on a robot.

held_out.quote: tasks that a controller was never trained for

items.title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
items.summary_zh: SkillScriptBench 评测 Agent 对技能包说明和可执行脚本的修复，检查验证反馈下的修订、文档与代码一致性及原有正确行为的保留。它适合作为 Harness 专项评测。故障均为构造或注入，局部维护结果尚不能证明跨任务长期自主演化或下游系统的普遍可靠性。
items.summary_en: SkillScriptBench evaluates repairs to skill-package instructions and executable scripts, including feedback-guided revision, documentation–code consistency, and preservation of correct behavior. It is a Harness-specific evaluation. Its faults are constructed or injected, so local maintenance results do not establish long-term autonomous evolution across tasks or general downstream reliability.

Uses action-prediction errors on offline logs to propose textual skill-library edits, selects and retains versions by development-set scores, then freezes the library for new tasks. Optimization executes no live actions; its feedback is an offline proxy, not an online execution loop or evidence of universally superior performance at matched cost.
items.summary_zh: 用离线日志上的动作预测误差提出文本技能库改动，以开发集评分选择并保留版本，再冻结用于新任务。优化期间不执行实时动作，反馈属于离线代理指标，不能据此声称在线执行闭环或同预算全面领先。
items.title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry

items.short_title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
items.summary_en: A preregistered evaluation compares simple configurations around frozen models, a rescue configuration and GEPA-selected prompts to examine whether Harness-search gains come from answer parseability, baseline choice or evaluation defects. Injected-defect comparisons show that replication through the same pipeline can reproduce a defect’s distortion instead of revealing it.
items.summary_zh: 预注册评测比较冻结模型周围的简单配置、救援配置与 GEPA 选出的提示，追查 Harness 搜索增益究竟来自答案可解析性、基线选择还是评测缺陷。注入缺陷的对照显示，使用同一管线进行复制可能复现缺陷的影响，而不能揭示它。
items.title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
items.summary_zh: ST-Bench 包含在开发评分反馈下优化并跨查询复用的多 Agent 工作流，以及未参与优化的测试查询。作为 Harness 专项评测收录，不把其中一次性生成、固定提示或权重训练对照也称为递归改进。
items.summary_en: ST-Bench evaluates multi-agent workflows optimized with development-score feedback and reused across queries, including test queries not used in optimization. It is included as a Harness-focused evaluation; one-shot, fixed-prompt and weight-training baselines are not all recursive improvement methods.

items.title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
items.summary_zh: SkillForge 同时训练模型并维护外部技能库。它根据执行回报和失败轨迹生成子技能；试用技能达到使用次数门槛后转为活跃状态，稳定与退休再按表现和使用次数管理，更新后的技能库用于后续检索。它符合模型与 Harness 共演化；共享任务回报并不能单独确认每个技能的因果贡献，且教师会带入外部知识。
items.summary_en: SkillForge trains the model while maintaining an external skill library. Execution rewards and failure trajectories guide child-skill generation. Trial skills become active after a usage threshold; fitness and usage govern stabilization and retirement, and later rollouts retrieve from the revised library. This supports a model-and-Harness coevolution classification. Shared task rewards do not isolate each skill’s causal contribution, and the teacher can introduce external knowledge.

items.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
items.summary_zh: Skill-V 根据环境反馈同时训练策略权重和修订外部技能契约，契约包含程序步骤、适用条件和可执行判据。通过回放检查的契约作为新版本供后续任务使用；声明式操作受限，不是任意生成代码，也未证明每条技能的因果效果。
items.summary_en: Skill-V uses environment feedback to train policy weights and revise external skill contracts containing procedures, applicability conditions and executable criteria. Contracts admitted by replay checks become new versions for later tasks; declarative operations are restricted, rather than arbitrary generated code, and each skill’s causal effect is not established.

AgentSWE evaluates whether coding agents can use development feedback to build deployable agents, including prompts, tool orchestration, state management and output checks. Delivered snapshots are frozen for independent testing; reusable-policy evidence is distinguished from ordinary software-task outputs.
items.summary_zh: AgentSWE 评测编程 Agent 能否按开发反馈构建可交付的 Agent，包括提示、工具编排、状态管理和输出校验。最终交付快照冻结后再独立测试，可复用策略的证据与普通软件任务产物应区分。
items.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
items.summary_zh: Cortex 把开发者纠正转成回放任务，用真实执行对照和脚本闸门决定是否保留或删除编码 Agent 的技能与规则。通过的工件进入后续任务的 Harness；主要实验来自合成仓库，真实项目未产生学习，强模型收益和隔离设计也有限制。
items.summary_en: Cortex turns developer corrections into replay tasks, using execution comparisons and scripted gates to retain or prune coding-agent skills and rules. Admitted artifacts enter the Harness used for later tasks; the main experiments use synthetic repositories, with no learning result on a real project and limitations for strong models and isolation.

items.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
items.summary_zh: 开放世界、无真值验证器：任务层用「提出—试探—组合」对比步引导编辑，上层把编辑经验沉淀到持续改进 Harness。
items.summary_en: Open world without a ground-truth verifier: the task level guides edits through “propose–probe–compose” contrastive steps; the upper level distills editing experience into a continually improving harness.

items.title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
items.summary_zh: Reels-RSI 将视频制作反馈沉淀为跨作品运行的检查规则和可修订的导演手册，且保留人工应用环节。论文承认首轮评价有位置偏差，后续改写也没有应用；收录的是 Harness 组件机制，不是普遍有效的自进化结论。
items.summary_en: Reels-RSI turns video-production feedback into checks used across productions and a revisable director playbook, retaining a human application step. The paper acknowledges position bias in the initial evaluation and leaves a later rewrite unapplied; inclusion concerns the Harness-component mechanism, not a general claim of successful self-improvement.

items.title: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
items.summary_zh: 失败轨迹驱动修订，回放与配对评估决定保留，同 token 预算下仍有优势
items.summary_en: Failure traces drive revisions to evidence interfaces and reading skills; replay and paired evaluation select retained changes, with gains under a matched token budget.

cross_model.quote: The learned skills also transfer across executors

matched_budget.quote: The advantage persists at a matched input-token budget.

items.title: EvoQuantLab: Training-Free Dual-Loop Evolution for Auditable Quantitative Research
items.summary_zh: EvoQuantLab 在不训练模型权重的量化研究流程中，用开发阶段的搜索轨迹与过拟合诊断修订后续研究循环的协议、终端预算与约束，并将带父版本记录的子协议加载到下一轮。Harness 证据来自这层持久研究控制程序，内层生成的金融因子本身仍是任务产物；跨轮案例属于时间序列审计，不能单独归因为协议更新的因果收益。
items.summary_en: EvoQuantLab uses search traces and development-stage overfitting diagnostics to revise the protocol, terminal budgets, and constraints of subsequent quantitative research cycles without training model weights. Accepted child protocols retain their parent lineage and are loaded in the next cycle. The Harness evidence concerns this persistent research controller, not the generated financial factors; the cycle case study is a temporal audit rather than a causal comparison.

Repairs generator operators, prompts and skills from construction failures, validates them through regression checks and retains versions for later rounds while also training learner weights. This supports a limited weight-and-Harness coevolution classification; aggregate gains do not isolate the effect of generator repair.
items.summary_zh: 根据构造错误修改并回归验证生成器的算子、提示与技能，保留版本供后续轮次复用，同时迭代训练学习器权重。属于限定的权重与 Harness 共演化；整体收益不能单独归因于生成器修复。
items.title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills

items.summary_en: The student writes and revises transferable Skill files through practice, then reuses them on held-out cases in new sessions.

items.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
items.summary_zh: 把 Harness 自进化拆成「更新对象」与「提案/准入机制」，给出持续 PAC 学习下的泛化界、保留界与基于新鲜验证数据的准入规则。理论界依赖明确假设。
items.summary_en: Decomposes harness self-evolution into update targets and proposal/admission mechanisms, providing generalization bounds, retention bounds, and admission rules based on fresh validation data under continual PAC learning. The theoretical bounds depend on explicit assumptions.

gate.improved_object_zh: 可复用代码技能与诊断教训

items.summary_en: Turns Playground execution feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons, then freezes them for independent agents in unseen scenes, with additional cross-task and cross-model reuse tests. Model weights stay fixed; the execution-cost comparison excludes experience-acquisition cost.
items.summary_zh: 把 Playground 运行反馈转为可复用代码技能与诊断经验，冻结后交给新场景中的独立执行 Agent；另有跨任务、跨模型复用实验。模型权重保持不变，执行阶段费用对比不包含经验获取成本。
items.title: EmbodiedEvo: Self-improving Coding Agents for Physical Intelligence

items.short_title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs
items.summary_en: PLVR searches external tool-control programs, executes candidates and selects retained versions using teacher-action distance and training-task outcomes before freezing them for new tasks. It uses a handwritten seed and a library of primitives and rules generated by frontier models from teacher traces.
items.summary_zh: PLVR 搜索外部工具调用控制程序，实际执行候选后依据教师动作距离和训练任务结果选择保留版本，冻结后用于新任务。程序依赖人工种子与前沿模型从教师轨迹生成的原语和规则库。
items.title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough
CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
items.summary_zh: CarryOn 根据执行失败修订恢复技能的控制参数和控制流，把通过检查的改动保存为下一版技能库。模型权重固定；论文中的累计失败重试不等同于独立留出集泛化。
items.summary_en: CarryOn revises recovery control parameters and control flow after execution failures, saving admitted changes as the next skill-library version. Model weights remain fixed; cumulative retries of failed episodes do not establish independent held-out generalization.

items.title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
items.short_title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
items.summary_zh: Multimodal Filesystem Memory 允许 Agent 根据执行结果创建、修改和停用文本或可执行 procedure，并在后续生命与任务中复用。Harness 证据来自可修改的过程技能分支；位置笔记和工作记忆仍属于记忆内容。这些技能复用结果不代表所有任务成功率提高，也不意味着每个存储过程都有益或技能库越大越好。
items.summary_en: Multimodal Filesystem Memory lets an agent create, revise, and disable textual or executable procedures using execution feedback, then reuse them in later lives and tasks. The Harness evidence concerns editable procedural skills; spatial notes and working-memory content remain a separate memory branch. These skill-reuse results do not establish a success-rate improvement across all tasks, nor do they show that every stored procedure is beneficial or that a larger skill library is always better.

items.title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents

gate.improved_object_zh: 注入的微技能与工具集

items.summary_zh: 跨任务序列根据经验注入技能、裁剪长期无用工具，作用于 Claude Code/Codex/Copilot CLI
items.summary_en: Across tasks, the controller injects experience-driven micro-skills and removes persistently unused tools for Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI.

cross_model.quote: Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI

items.title: R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary_zh: 在训练中按反馈共演化编排模型与版本化技能；部署时不携带技能。
items.summary_en: Co-evolves Director weights and versioned skills using execution feedback during training; deployment uses no skills.

items.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
items.summary_zh: H-step 由当前策略分析自身失败并提出 Harness 候选；P-step 在选定 Harness 下做 RL；仍未解决的任务成为下一轮搜索集。
items.summary_en: In the H-step, the current policy analyzes its own failures and proposes harness candidates; in the P-step, it performs RL under the selected harness; still-unsolved tasks become the next round’s search set.

items.title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
items.summary_zh: 冻结执行模型，依据执行反例修订可重跑检查器，并将验收后的验证器版本与修复记录带入后续改进轮次。跨任务改进构造器的循环尚未评测。
items.summary_en: With the actor frozen, execution counterexamples revise reusable checkers; accepted verifier versions and repair records carry into later improvement rounds. Cross-task adaptation of the constructor is not evaluated.

items.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 每次失败后读日志写或修工具，冻结后在新布局上测试
items.summary_en: After failures, the agent reads logs and writes or repairs perception tools; the tools are frozen before testing on new layouts.

held_out.quote: test them on ten new layouts of the same seed

items.title: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
items.summary_zh: IRAH 根据真实检索评分反思并变异检索流水线配置，搜索检索器、切分器、重排器的结构和设置。优化查询选出的配置保留用于独立留出查询，不等于整个 Agent 自改代码或同步训练全部模型。
items.summary_en: IRAH reflects on retrieval scores and mutates retrieval-pipeline configurations, searching retriever, chunker and reranker structures and settings. Configurations selected on optimization queries are retained for independent held-out queries; this is not whole-agent self-rewriting or joint training of every model.

items.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_zh: IF-MAP 用端到端执行损失选择值得改进的 Agent 节点，再由文本反馈优化器迭代该节点的提示。通过开发集检查的提示被保留用于后续测试，收录范围是反馈驱动的目标选择与提示优化组件。
items.summary_en: IF-MAP uses end-to-end execution loss to prioritize agent nodes, then iterates their prompts through a textual-feedback optimizer. Prompts admitted by development-set checks are retained for later testing; the included scope is feedback-driven target selection and prompt optimization.

items.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
items.summary_zh: 元 Agent 借共享演化档案双向继承历史 Harness 与模型检查点，用自身拒绝采样轨迹微调，缓解「脑体错配」。
items.summary_en: A meta agent uses a shared evolutionary archive for bidirectional inheritance of historical harnesses and model checkpoints, fine-tuning on its own rejection-sampled trajectories to mitigate “brain–body mismatch.”

items.title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
items.short_title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
items.summary_zh: 该 Harness 将原始目标、可修改计划与执行记录分离，由 planner、worker、reviewer 协作；setup agent 根据试运行轨迹和工具反馈修订可复用指令。在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上通过 89 个实例中的 83 个（93.26%）；结果针对完整配置，未隔离指令演化的单独贡献。
items.summary_en: The harness separates the original objective from mutable plans and execution records, with planner, worker, and reviewer roles; a setup agent revises reusable instructions from trial trajectories and tool feedback. It passes 83 of 89 Terminal-Bench 2.1 instances (93.26%); these results concern the complete configuration, without isolating instruction evolution.

items.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
items.summary_zh: HarnessRL 在政策权重训练的同时，根据反馈迭代任务采样、rollout 指导和评分标准等外部训练接口。候选经当前冻结政策上的测量后准入并用于后续训练；这种阶段性冻结不代表模型权重始终固定。
items.summary_en: HarnessRL updates external training interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance and rubrics alongside policy-weight training. Candidates are admitted after measurement against the currently frozen policy and retained for later training; this temporary freeze does not mean model weights remain fixed throughout.

items.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
items.summary_zh: 无标签：用模型生成的测试评价候选，不访问标准答案或官方测试；按性能与成本的不同偏好产出 lite、medium、heavy 三档。
items.summary_en: Label-free: evaluates candidates with model-generated tests, without accessing standard answers or official tests; produces lite, medium, and heavy tiers for different performance–cost preferences.

items.title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
items.summary_zh: 不更新权重，按组内相对比较把团队奖励归因到具体技能再修订
items.summary_en: Relative within-group comparisons attribute team rewards to individual skills for revision without updating model weights.

items.title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
items.summary_zh: 无标签设置下跨问题演化工具，只保留 Worker 复跑时采用且有证据支持的修改
items.summary_en: Tools evolve across unlabeled problems; changes are retained only when the Worker adopts them on replay and the answer has supporting trajectory evidence.

matched_budget.quote: lifting Sonnet-5 at 15 steps by 9.3 points

items.title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
items.summary_zh: 针对重复运行时时成时败的任务：结合 Agent 轨迹与运行时内部追踪，用 Harness Handbook 把行为映射到源码，并检索其他框架的实现作参考。
items.summary_en: Targets tasks with inconsistent success across repeated runs: combines agent trajectories and internal runtime traces, maps behavior to source code using a Harness Handbook, and retrieves implementations from other frameworks as references.

items.title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization
items.short_title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization
items.summary_zh: 借鉴 RL 的 pass@k 分析，对比优化前后的 Harness，区分增益来自已有能力更可靠地发挥还是可解任务范围扩大。所测设置中，pass@1 优势可能在更大尝试预算下反转，属于 Harness 专项诊断评测。
items.summary_en: Drawing on RL pass@k analysis, the study compares harnesses before and after optimization to distinguish more reliable elicitation from broader task coverage. In the evaluated settings, pass@1 advantages can reverse at larger attempt budgets; this is a focused diagnostic evaluation of harness optimization.

items.title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
items.summary_zh: RL 期间，一个教师生成任务相关的机制级技能，另一个根据反复出现的交互问题演化工具和 hooks；只保留使通过率或可训练率提高且另一指标不降的修改。
items.summary_en: During RL, one teacher generates task-related mechanism-level skills, while another evolves tools and hooks from recurring interaction problems; retains only edits that improve pass rate or trainability without lowering the other metric.

items.title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
items.summary_zh: ChartEvo 通过经验驱动的 harness 级自我改进，联合演化可复用的图表 Skills 与 Tools 并学习局部工具调用链，在 ChartBench 与 ChartX 长尾图表上提升了 base MLLM 的准确率。
items.summary_en: ChartEvo improves base MLLM accuracy on long-tail charts in ChartBench and ChartX via experience-driven harness-level self-improvement, jointly evolving reusable chart Skills and Tools and learning local tool-call chains.

items.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
items.summary_zh: 元 Agent 阅读合成任务上的无成功标签轨迹，写入并修订接口仓库；种群选择按元 Agent 看不到的验证任务决定保留哪些仓库。
items.summary_en: A meta agent reads trajectories without success labels on synthetic tasks, writing and revising interface repositories; population selection retains repositories using validation tasks hidden from the meta agent.

Turns differences between fixed teacher and student execution traces into task-general operating rules, progressively patching a reusable skill for later held-out tasks while student weights remain fixed. The rules cover tool use, verification, stopping and retries. The default pipeline adds no environment calls or post-patch evaluation-based selection; the separate SkillOpt variant retains a validation gate, which should not be attributed to the default pipeline.
items.summary_zh: 将固定的教师与学生执行轨迹差异转成任务通用操作规则，逐批修改并保留可复用技能，供后续独立任务加载；规则涉及工具调用、验证、停止与重试，学生权重保持不变。默认流程不增加环境调用，也不逐次评测筛选补丁；另设的 SkillOpt 变体保留验证门，不能混称为默认在线自评循环。
items.title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
items.summary_zh: 该方法用拟合后冻结的线性 readout 在执行前给脚手架代码修改打分，再依据 steering-split 反馈选择并保留候选。GPT-4o 实验返回节点在留出 HumanEval+ 上的得分为 87.0%，parent-rate 消融为 84.2%；这些百分比是得分，不是返回节点的比例。
items.summary_en: A linear readout, frozen after fitting, scores scaffold-code edits before execution, followed by candidate selection and retention using steering-split feedback. In the GPT-4o experiment, returned nodes score 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, versus 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation; these percentages are scores, not proportions of nodes returned.

items.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 固定 VLA 执行器，可编辑 Harness 依执行经验自进化
items.summary_en: The VLM planner evolves its editable Harness from execution experience while the VLA executor remains fixed.

items.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
items.summary_zh: SCOPE 将自然语言政策编译为外部谓词程序，根据执行跟踪和对抗样例修订抽取器、谓词及组合逻辑，并保留或回退候选。收录其策略执行 Harness 组件，标签池变化不等于模型权重训练。
items.summary_en: SCOPE compiles natural-language policies into external predicate programs, revising extractors, predicates and composition logic using execution traces and adversarial cases while retaining or reverting candidates. The included component is policy-enforcement Harness optimization; changes to a label pool are not model-weight training.

items.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
items.summary_zh: Phronix 通过 predictor-validator-corrector 循环，依据工具执行结果改进并保留 MCP 工具与关联技能。对冷启动已解决的任务，继承其能力库的热启动运行首次尝试成功率为 93-95%；该比例的分母不包括冷启动未解决的任务。
items.summary_en: Phronix uses a predictor-validator-corrector loop to refine and retain MCP tools and associated skills from execution outcomes. Among tasks already solved during cold-start runs, warm-start runs inheriting the capability store achieve 93-95% first-attempt success; tasks not solved in cold-start runs are outside that denominator.

items.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
items.summary_zh: 从已验证项目提炼可复用协作契约供后续开发；自进化仅在经验消融中评估。
items.summary_en: Distills reusable collaboration contracts from validated projects for later development; self-evolution is evaluated separately through an experience-bundle ablation.

items.title: RSI-Opt: Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents For Model Training
items.summary_zh: RSI-Opt 的 meta-agent 根据历史运行证据改写可复用的提示、playbook、优化器代码库和决策节奏，并归档策略供后续运行继承。模型训练是应用任务；递归继承的独立增益缺少匹配预算对照，且曾发生留出任务描述被读取的情况。
items.summary_en: RSI-Opt uses historical run evidence to revise a reusable prompt, playbook, optimizer-code library, and decision cadence, archiving policies for later runs. Model training is the application task; the isolated benefit of recursive inheritance lacks a matched-budget control, and a held-out task description was accessed during development.

items.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
items.summary_zh: HarnessMM 在 actor 权重固定时复用已有决策，减少后续推理调用；另用训练反馈和验证选择迭代改进配套 Harness 配置。DeepSeek Harness 的完整配置报告成功率上升、Tokens/task 下降，不能把全部收益归因于单一 RSI 或替换组件。
items.summary_en: HarnessMM reuses resolved decisions to reduce later reasoning calls with fixed actor weights, while training feedback and validation selection iteratively refine companion harness configurations. The full DeepSeek Harness configuration reports higher success and lower Tokens/task; the entire gain cannot be attributed to RSI or callback substitution alone.

items.title: AgentOrch: How Close Can Global Orchestration Come to Step-by-Step Interaction?
items.summary_zh: AgentOrch 的 Replan 分支根据工具执行和控制流反馈重写完整工作流，并固定复用于同一流程的新输入。本次仅收录该工作流改进分支；另行进行的权重训练不能据此称为 Harness 共演化。
items.summary_en: The Replan branch of AgentOrch rewrites complete workflows from tool-execution and control-flow feedback, then reuses them unchanged on new inputs for the same procedure. Only this workflow-improvement branch is included; separate weight training does not establish Harness coevolution.

items.title: ReSight: Task-Driven Self-Improving Memory for Embodied Agents
items.summary_zh: ReSight 用 Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) 把探索所得解转为可复用的记忆构建器、查询工具与技能，扩展具身智能体的记忆访问能力，使 OC-NaVQA 平均位置误差从 33.10 m 降至 24.72 m。
items.summary_en: ReSight's Explore-Distill-Mount (EDM) converts exploration-derived solutions into reusable memory builders, query tools, and skills, expanding embodied agents' memory access; OC-NaVQA average position error falls from 33.10 m to 24.72 m.

held_out.quote: episodes excluded from exploration and distillation

matched_budget.quote: online budget held fixed within each benchmark

items.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_zh: 用执行反馈分别修订协调者与执行器提示，经验证集选择后用于后续任务。
items.summary_en: Uses execution feedback to revise coordinator and executor prompts separately, selecting prompts on validation tasks for subsequent use.

items.title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
items.short_title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
items.summary_zh: 研究让 retro 回顾 Claude Code 在 30 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上的会话并提出 Harness 修改，研究者选择实施 24 个提案；其中可评估的变更与一个作者另写的对照一起用于后续任务评测。多数遇到目标问题的评估未减少重复工作；这是含人工选择的专项评测。
items.summary_en: The study uses retro to review Claude Code sessions on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues and propose harness changes. Researchers select 24 proposals for implementation and evaluate the resulting eligible changes alongside an author-written comparison on later tasks. Most evaluations encountering the target problem show no reduction in repeated work; selection involves humans.

items.title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
items.summary_zh: VISTA 用 Harness graph 保留版本与证据，元代理主动生成 rollout、探测失败并修订指令、可执行技能及协调逻辑。仿真实验中相对静态反思报告更高成功率和更少 rollout；效率优势本身不能证明预算完全匹配。
items.summary_en: VISTA retains harness versions and evidence in a graph while a meta-agent actively generates rollouts, probes failures, and revises instructions, executable skills, and coordination logic. Simulation experiments report higher success with fewer rollouts than static reflection; efficiency alone does not establish fully matched budgets.

items.title: RSIV-Harness: A Recursive Self-Improvement Harness Framework for Open-Domain Conversational Text-to-Visualization
items.summary_zh: RSIV-Harness 固定模型权重，依据失败轨迹修改 Harness，以 anchor 和 memory 检查保留或回滚。相对总体结果表中原骨干的静态 Harness，可执行性提高 +28.02 点、图表结构提高 +34.01 点；消融表的基线数值与总体结果表不一致，跨骨干也并非全部指标提升。
items.summary_en: RSIV-Harness fixes model weights, revises the harness from failure traces, and uses anchor and memory checks for retention or rollback. Relative to the original-backbone static harness in the overall-results table, executability rises by +28.02 points and chart structure by +34.01. The ablation table reports an inconsistent baseline, and transfer does not improve every metric.

items.title: Skill^{infty}: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Skill Optimization
items.summary_zh: 元技能用同一流程优化任务技能并优化自身
items.summary_en: A meta-skill uses the same optimization loop to improve task skills and itself.

items.title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
items.short_title: Hierarchical Skill Evolution for Coding Agent
items.summary_zh: HSE 在冻结编码模型下，分层聚合任务、仓库与跨仓库证据；反馈既演化技能，也更新 writer/evaluator 的外部规则与证据权重，并传给后续轮次。目标基准适配阶段固定这些规则，只更新技能库。
items.summary_en: With the coding model frozen, HSE aggregates task, repository, and cross-repository evidence. Feedback evolves skills and also updates the external writer/evaluator rules and evidence weights, which are transferred to later rounds. Target-benchmark adaptation fixes those rules and updates only the skill library.

cross_model.quote: demonstrating transfer across benchmarks, coding models

items.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary_zh: 按执行反馈修订冻结模型外的协议模块并沿固定能力树继承；评测技能另行准备。
items.summary_en: Revises protocol modules around a frozen model using execution feedback and inherits them along a fixed capability tree; evaluation skills are prepared separately.

items.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
items.summary_zh: Skill Dreaming 从 PR 流中提取可执行知识，构建仓库专属技能库并持续精炼，用于指导编码代理实现功能，并同步维护测试、文档与仓库约定。
items.summary_en: Skill Dreaming extracts executable knowledge from PR streams, builds and continuously refines a repository-specific skill library to guide coding agents implementing features while synchronously maintaining tests, documentation, and repository conventions.

This work batches GEPA's reflective proposals, execution and validation, updating a retained candidate frontier and testing optimized prompts on held-out tasks. It improves a Harness-optimization component; it does not demonstrate recursive evolution of the optimizer itself.
items.summary_zh: 本文把 GEPA 的反思候选提出、执行和验证改为批量处理，持续更新被保留的候选前沿，并在留出任务上测试优化后的提示。属于 Harness 优化器组件改进，不能据此称为改进器自身递归演化。
items.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: RuHarness 让评分准则与 harness 共同演化：从执行轨迹持续发现并重估行为准则，优先处理最相关的未解决弱点以指导 harness 更新，在未见任务上优于强 harness 演化基线。
items.summary_en: RuHarness co-evolves scoring criteria and harness: continuously discovering and re-evaluating behavioral criteria from trajectories, prioritizing most relevant unresolved weaknesses to guide harness updates, outperforming strong harness-evolution baselines on unseen tasks.

items.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.summary_zh: 策展任务与轨迹以修订提示和 Harness 代码，迭代保留候选并按验证表现选优。
items.summary_en: Curates tasks and trajectories for feedback-driven prompt and harness-code revisions, carries candidates through iterations, and selects final versions by validation performance.

items.title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
items.summary_zh: FilingLoop 用已评分批次的要求级反馈改写 Reviewer 与 Filer 的程序性技能，供后续未尝试的案例使用，模型权重保持不变；这是在线历史反馈适应，不能视为独立留出集验证。
items.summary_en: FilingLoop revises procedural Reviewer and Filer skills from requirement-level feedback on scored batches and applies them to later unattempted cases with fixed model weights. This is online adaptation from historical feedback, not an independent held-out evaluation.

items.title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents
items.summary_zh: Masked Erosion 研究固定模型外部的文本 Harness 在接受闸门下如何逐步丢失冗余安全约束：被接受的修改成为后续父代。主要实验人为施加删除压力，用于隔离闸门行为，不能概括为部署中的普遍失效率。
items.summary_en: Masked Erosion studies how acceptance gates can erode redundant safeguards in a textual harness around a fixed model, with accepted edits becoming later parents. Most experiments deliberately impose deletion pressure to isolate gate behavior, rather than estimate general deployment failure rates.

items.title: Appreciation Teaches Unauthorized Execution: Self-Evolution Degrades the Robustness of Personal Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection
items.summary_zh: 该安全评测研究用户赞许如何影响个人代理面对间接提示注入时的授权判断。MetaClaw 把会话反馈写成可复用技能并用于后续会话；技能演化和强化学习权重更新是分别测试的分支，不能当成同一代理的协同演化。
items.summary_en: This safety evaluation studies how user appreciation affects personal agents’ authorization judgments under indirect prompt injection. MetaClaw turns session feedback into reusable skills for later conversations; skill evolution and reinforcement-learning weight updates are separately tested branches, not joint co-evolution in one agent.

items.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
items.summary_zh: 依据执行失败诊断修订存储、检索与上下文设计，经验证择优保留，并冻结设计跨基准复用。
items.summary_en: Revises storage, retrieval, and context designs using execution diagnostics, retains validation improvements, and transfers frozen designs across benchmarks.

items.title: Before the Next Rollout: Diagnosing Skill Utility Shifts from Policy Updates
items.summary_zh: 研究在策略权重更新后诊断技能效用变化，并用 readout 和失败轨迹指导技能编辑。在闭环实验中，编辑器修改文本技能库，配对验证决定是否保留到后续窗口；独立诊断实验则固定技能库。
items.summary_en: The study diagnoses changes in skill utility after policy-weight updates and uses readouts and failed trajectories to guide skill edits. In closed-loop experiments, an editor revises the textual skill bank and paired validation decides retention for later windows; the separate diagnostic experiments keep the skill bank fixed.

items.title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
items.summary_zh: 该方法把技能执行中的不确定操作编译为程序，利用执行错误和检查差异修订技能与代码，并保存验证后的程序资产供后续技能复用。开发时曾查看留出失败案例，测试期冻结资产库并不意味着完全独立的留出验证。
items.summary_en: The method compiles uncertain skill operations into programs, repairs skills and code using execution errors and check discrepancies, and retains validated program assets for later skills. Development inspected held-out failures, so a frozen asset bank at test time does not establish fully independent held-out validation.

items.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
items.summary_zh: 依据执行反馈更新团队规则和技能，保留改动供后续团队协作与任务复用。
items.summary_en: Uses execution feedback to revise team rules and procedural skills, retaining updates for subsequent collaboration and tasks.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 梳理视频 Harness 演化，并区分产物修复、跨任务保留和改进过程更新。
items.summary_en: Surveys video-harness evolution, separating output repair, retained cross-task changes, and updates to the improvement procedure.

items.title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
items.summary_zh: 用漏洞与修复函数对的反馈修订 Python Harness，保留候选并以冻结版本评测未见数据和模型。
items.summary_en: Refines Python harnesses from vulnerable and patched function feedback, retains candidates, and evaluates frozen harnesses on unseen data and models.

items.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
items.summary_zh: 以执行反馈演化冻结教师的 Harness，再固定该版本生成学生训练轨迹。
items.summary_en: Evolves a frozen teacher’s harness using execution feedback, then reuses the selected version to generate student training trajectories.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.summary_zh: 用执行反馈和配对检验演化冻结教师的工具与恢复逻辑，再蒸馏小模型。
items.summary_en: Evolves a frozen teacher’s tools and recovery logic with execution feedback and paired tests, then distills a compact model.

items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.summary_zh: 在仿真中用轨迹反馈修订冻结策略外的控制代码，并在留出任务评估。
items.summary_en: Uses rollout feedback to revise control code around a frozen robotic policy, evaluating retained harnesses on held-out tasks in simulation.

items.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
items.summary_zh: 用质量与成本反馈筛选 Harness 更新，并保留已完成开发评估的候选供后续优化。
items.summary_en: Uses quality and cost feedback to promote revised harnesses and retains candidates evaluated on development tasks for later optimization.

items.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.summary_zh: 将失败轨迹转成操作技能，经独立测试和修订后保留，供后续适用任务复用。
items.summary_en: Turns failed traces into procedural skills, tests and revises them with a separate agent, then retains them for later applicable tasks.

items.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.short_title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.summary_zh: 评测编码 Harness 跨任务持续演化中的遗忘，跟踪提示、工具和执行逻辑变化。
items.summary_en: Studies forgetting during continual coding-harness evolution across tasks, tracking changes to prompts, tools, and execution logic.

EvoGroup selects interaction trajectories using confidence and official task outcomes, then uses the diagnosis to revise tool implementations, retrieval algorithms, prompts, and scheduling policies. The evolved harness is frozen and evaluated on an unseen group-conversation memory benchmark. Its Harness evidence comes from program and policy updates, beyond accumulated memory content; the use of official correctness feedback is not fully unsupervised.
items.summary_zh: EvoGroup 根据置信度与官方任务结果选择交互轨迹，再用诊断结果指导修改工具实现、检索算法以及提示和调度策略。演化后的 Harness 冻结后在未见的群聊记忆基准上评估。纳入依据是可执行程序与策略的更新；仅增加群聊记忆内容不构成这些证据，也不能把官方正确性反馈称为完全无监督。
items.title: EvoGroup: A Self-Evolving Harness for Group Agents in Shared Contexts
Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
items.summary_zh: 根据失败反馈修订指令和技能，经过回归检查后合并，供后续任务复用。
items.summary_en: Revises instructions and procedural skills from failure feedback, validates changes for regressions, and merges them for subsequent tasks.

items.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
items.summary_zh: 按失败原因编辑并保留多种Harness，再用固定变体池辅助策略训练。
items.summary_en: Failure-guided edits create a reusable harness pool, which stays fixed while supporting policy training.

DualEvolve improves both recommendation solutions and research orchestration. Its outer loop uses process scores and execution traces to add, retire, or merge harness and skill rules that guide later search rounds. The recommendation model is an external research artifact, so the dual-level design alone does not establish coevolution of the agent backbone and harness. The paper also evaluates transfer with frozen rules; reported transfer costs exclude source-rule acquisition.
items.summary_zh: DualEvolve 在推荐研究中同时改进任务方案和研究编排：外层依据过程评分与执行轨迹增删、合并 Harness 和技能规则，影响后续轮次的搜索。内层改进的推荐模型是外部研究产物，因此不能仅凭“双层”认定 Agent 自身权重与 Harness 共演化。论文另评估冻结规则的迁移，但报告的迁移成本不含源规则获取成本。
items.title: DualEvolve: Dual-Level Self-Evolution of Mechanism and Orchestration for Recommendation

items.summary_en: Meta² compares training trajectories and verifier feedback offline to iteratively revise Meta-Skill rules for when and how to intervene. At deployment, these improver rules are frozen and reused to guide harness edits on new tasks. Each online edit affects only its active run and is discarded afterward, without being written back to the Meta-Skill. The inherited artifact is improver decision guidance, rather than a growing collection of global deployment patches.
items.summary_zh: Meta² 在离线阶段比较训练轨迹与验证反馈，迭代增删 Meta-Skill 中决定何时、如何干预的规则。部署时冻结这套改进器规则，复用于新任务的 Harness 编辑；每次在线编辑只影响当前运行，结束后丢弃，并不写回 Meta-Skill。这里跨任务保留的是改进器决策规则，不能描述成部署时持续积累全局 Harness 补丁。
items.title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents

items.summary_en: Reglos separates accumulation of user-memory content from improvement of the harness program. An outer coding agent proposes patches to retrieval, ranking, and evidence construction from failure traces, with an independent critic and evaluation selecting retained changes. The qualifying artifact is the program around a frozen task model; the improver and verifier remain fixed. The stricter acceptance rule was adopted after the reported harness was frozen, so it must not be attributed retroactively to all development edits.
items.summary_zh: Reglos 将用户记忆内容的积累与 Harness 程序的改进分开。外层编码 Agent 从失败轨迹提出检索、过滤排序和证据组织的程序补丁，经独立 critic 与评估筛选后保留。纳入的是这套围绕冻结任务模型的程序更新，改进器和验证器本身保持固定。论文在冻结报告版本之后才采用更严格的准入规则，不能称之前的开发改动都通过了该规则。
items.title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement

items.summary_en: HarnessFlow uses MCTS to allocate search across refinement paths of executable harnesses. A coding agent uses a parent design, validation feedback, and execution records to revise context construction, state management, tool use, and stopping rules; candidates and scores persist in the search tree. The harness selected on validation is evaluated on a disjoint test set. Matching candidate-attempt counts does not establish matching total tokens, dollar cost, or compute.
items.summary_zh: HarnessFlow 用 MCTS 在可执行 Harness 的不同修订路径之间分配搜索。编码 Agent 根据父版本、验证反馈和执行记录提出上下文构造、状态管理、工具使用及终止规则的改动，候选与分数保留在搜索树中供后续迭代。最终按验证集选择的 Harness 再在不相交测试集评估；对齐候选尝试次数不等于对齐全部 token、费用或算力。
items.title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
items.summary_zh: 执行反馈推动机器人技能代码修订与保留，既有技能库可用于新任务。
items.summary_en: Execution feedback revises reusable robot skills, and retained primitives support development on new tasks.

items.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
items.summary_zh: 依据逐步收到的评分反馈修订评审提示词，验证后的版本用于后续样本；实验反馈仍属理想化设置。
items.summary_en: Observed rating feedback updates judge prompts; validated revisions are reused on later samples under idealized feedback.

items.title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
items.summary_zh: 仅将其中按执行反馈保留的工具与访问接口优化纳入 Harness；普通环境文件重排不计入此范围。
items.summary_en: Only feedback-driven, retained tool and access-interface revisions qualify here as Harness components; ordinary environment restructuring does not.

items.title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
items.short_title: The Last Mile to the Real World
items.summary_zh: 开发 Agent 根据失败轨迹修订 Harness 控制原语，经测试与开发集检查后保留，供独立任务复用；仅收录其 Harness 原语分支。
items.summary_en: A development agent revises Harness control primitives from failure traces and retains validated primitives after tests and development-set checks for reuse on separate tasks; only the Harness-primitives branch is included.

IAPO uses execution-trajectory returns to certify candidate policies for multi-agent orchestration. Its discrete plan-leap branch searches role-call sequences, selects plans using paired returns on separate validation data, and reruns the frozen policy on test data. Inclusion concerns the method and theory for reusable orchestration plans. A single-round experiment is not recursive self-modification of the improver, and a validation-distribution certificate does not guarantee test gains. Reported per-problem deployment costs exclude search and training.
items.summary_zh: IAPO 利用执行轨迹回报为多 Agent 编排的候选策略建立改进证书。其中离散 plan-leap 分支搜索角色调用序列，以独立验证中的配对回报选择计划，再冻结策略于测试集重跑。纳入的是可复用编排计划的方法与理论；论文的单轮实验不等于改进器递归自改，验证分布上的证书也不保证测试提升。部署期每题成本未计入搜索与训练开销。
items.title: Learning Multi-Agent Orchestration:Higher-Order Interactions in Policy Improvement
Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
items.summary_zh: 以冻结模型比较 Harness 演化，分别追踪收益、退化、部署成本和跨基准迁移，并审计候选保留机制。
items.summary_en: Compares Harness evolution with frozen models, tracking gains, regressions, deployment costs, transfer, and candidate retention.

items.title: ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance
items.summary_zh: 交互失败触发可复用澄清技能更新，并在空闲期优化责任模块适配器；变更只影响后续交互。
items.summary_en: Interaction failures update reusable clarification skills, while idle periods train the responsible adapter; updates affect later interactions.

items.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
items.short_title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 冻结执行模型与底层原语，评测反馈驱动的技能库迭代，区分验证器适配与跨任务迁移。
items.summary_en: Evaluates feedback-driven skill-library revisions with a frozen actor, distinguishing verifier adaptation from cross-task transfer.

DeCAF divides Harness search into dimensions such as prompts, topology, model assignment, context and tool policies. It iterates using development-set execution results, retains non-dominated candidates, then uses component diagnostics to compose, repair and select a final pipeline for held-out evaluation. Diagnostics locate likely failures; admission still depends on task performance, inference cost and latency. Optimizer repeats are few, inference cost rises on some benchmarks and total optimization cost is higher, so a strictly cost-matched advantage is not established.
items.summary_zh: DeCAF 将 Harness 搜索拆为提示、拓扑、模型分配、上下文和工具策略等维度，以开发集执行结果迭代修改并保留非支配候选，再用组件诊断合成、修复并选择最终程序，在留出集评测。组件诊断只定位可能的失败，准入仍依据任务表现、推理费用和延迟。优化器重复次数少，部分基准推理费用上升，优化总费用也更高，未证明严格同费用预算优势。
items.title: Divide, Diagnose, and Compose: Optimizing Agentic Pipelines and Harnesses

items.short_title: How Much Skill Orchestration Can LLM Agents Compile Away? Execution-Grounded Specialization for Token-Efficient Skill Use
items.summary_en: SkillCache compiles a completed invocation trace into a parameterized capsule of programs and natural-language steps. A host replays candidates in a sandbox, returns failure diagnostics to the compiler agent for repair, and retains qualified capsules for later requests while keeping the source skill for recovery. This execution-feedback repair loop qualifies as component evolution; continued learning from warm executions remains future work. Replay uses the original request conditions, so it does not guarantee arbitrary new requests, and savings depend on compilation cost and reuse frequency.
items.summary_zh: SkillCache 将已完成调用的工具轨迹编译成参数化 capsule，包含程序和自然语言步骤。宿主在沙箱回放候选，把失败诊断反馈给编译 Agent 修复，通过后供后续请求复用，原技能保留作恢复路径。纳入的是这条执行反馈修订组件的闭环；当前 warm 执行后的持续学习仍属未来工作。回放主要检查原请求条件，不能保证任意新请求正确，节省也需结合编译成本和复用次数判断。
items.title: How Much Skill Orchestration Can LLM Agents Compile Away? Execution-Grounded Specialization for Token-Efficient Skill Use

items.summary_en: WAAC retains field-compression policies in a history store after task-success verification and retrieves them for compatible later workflows. Only policies actually validated and applied can become successful precedents; unverified executions are not treated as successes. The qualifying component is a feedback-selected, reusable compression policy. Matching and fusion remain fixed, so this is not evidence of self-rewriting compression source code or merely accumulating general experience content.
items.summary_zh: WAAC 把经过任务成功验证的字段压缩策略保留到历史库，并在后续兼容工作流中检索复用。只有实际通过验证、应用后的策略可成为成功先例，未经验证的执行不会被当作成功经验。纳入的是反馈筛选并保留的压缩策略组件；匹配与融合算法仍固定，不能描述成系统自行重写压缩源码，也不能把一般经验内容的积累算作同一种证据。
items.title: Rethinking Agent Trajectory Compression: A Workflow-Aware Perspective

items.summary_en: Flex-RSI separates solution improvement from harness improvement: an executor edits the task solution, while an improver uses trajectories and results to revise the executor and its own prompts, tools, and workflow for later rounds. Model weights, evaluators, and data splits stay fixed, and the final solution is evaluated on hidden test data. Paired frozen-harness runs study the contribution of harness editing. Uneven task coverage and generally single runs limit claims of robustness or cross-task transfer.
items.summary_zh: Flex-RSI 将任务解的改进与 Harness 改进分开：executor 修改解，improver 根据轨迹和结果改写 executor 及自身的提示、工具与工作流，后续轮次继续使用更新后的 Harness。模型权重、评估器和数据划分固定，最终解在隐藏测试集评分；论文另用冻结 Harness 配对运行检验 Harness 编辑的贡献。应归 Harness 专项评测，但各模型任务覆盖不齐、通常每格单次运行，不能据此夸大稳健性或跨任务迁移。
items.title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents

items.summary_en: BOXBOX lets an agent request reviews and rewrite its executable harness in response to difficulties during a long-running task. A kernel validates the changes and hot-reloads the runtime while preserving execution context; the revised harness governs later execution and reviews. PerfRace comparisons use matched task-time budgets against frozen, offline-evolved, and externally controlled harness baselines. This supports within-task inheritance across improvement rounds; independent cross-task transfer remains unknown and equal time does not imply equal dollar cost.
items.summary_zh: BOXBOX 让 Agent 在长时任务中根据执行困难主动复审并改写自己的可执行 Harness。kernel 验证改动后保留上下文、热加载新运行时，后续执行和复审继续使用新版。PerfRace 上与固定 Harness、离线 Harness Evolution 和外部控制的 Harness Scaling 比较，使用相同任务时间预算；这是任务内跨轮 Harness 演化证据，独立跨任务迁移仍为 unknown，不能把时间预算相同写成费用完全相同。
items.title: BOXBOX: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Long-Running Performance Optimization

items.summary_en: AutoRefine uses noisy workflow labels, such as merge and abandonment outcomes, to analyze judge-label mismatches and iteratively revise a deployable code-quality review prompt. A teacher may explain a mismatch or abstain, and a separate validation set selects the prompt. The updated artifact is the review component. Experiments replay saved patches without rerunning the agent under test, so better judging does not directly establish improved coding-task success.
items.summary_zh: AutoRefine 利用代码工作流中的合并、放弃等噪声标签，分析 judge 与标签的不一致，并反复改写可部署的质量评审提示。教师模型可以解释或弃权，候选提示由独立验证集选择。更新对象是评审组件的提示；实验重放已保存补丁，没有重新运行被评 Agent，因此不能将评审结果改善直接写成编码任务成功率提高。
items.title: AutoRefine: Auto-Calibrating Code Judges from Workflow Outcomes

items.summary_en: This SkillOpt security study asks whether a skill-optimization loop can turn poisoned reference feedback into persistent rules. In a short-answer setting, the natural reflection, editing, and selection chain retains a trigger-conditioned rule, whose role is examined through held-out activation and rule-removal tests. The natural chain in the structured-tool setting does not retain the same exact rule. This is Harness-specific security evaluation, not evidence of a universal effect across optimizers, models, or tasks.
items.summary_zh: 这项 SkillOpt 安全研究检验技能优化循环是否会把受污染的参考反馈变成持久规则。短答案任务的自然反思、编辑和选择链中，作者观察到触发条件规则被保留，并通过留出激活与规则删除实验检查其作用；结构化工具任务的自然链没有保留同样的精确规则。它属于 Harness 专项安全评测，不能推广为所有优化器、模型或任务都存在同样效果。
items.title: When Feedback Becomes a Backdoor: Tracing Backdoor Skill Formation in Text-Space Skill Optimization

items.summary_en: The Harness-relevant branch of From LoRA to Language is its reward loop for skill documents. A writer revises drafts across rounds using development-task success feedback, selects a version on unseen development games, and is evaluated separately on final tests. The document can be reused by an executing model. Inclusion is limited to feedback-driven skill revision; adapter recovery and writer training alone are not Harness evolution, and the gains should not all be attributed to reading LoRA.
items.summary_zh: From LoRA to Language 中与本专题直接相关的是技能文档的奖励循环：writer 根据开发任务的成功反馈逐轮修订草稿，再用未见的开发游戏选择版本，最终测试另行进行。技能文档可交给执行模型复用。收录仅针对这条反馈修订技能的分支，不把适配器恢复或 writer 训练本身当作 Harness 演化，也不把全部收益归因于读取 LoRA。
items.title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
items.summary_zh: CPU-ARC 将推理步骤实现为可复用的 Python 语义函数。构建器依据执行错误、judge 反馈和检查结果反复修改候选，通过后注册到系统级缓存，供后续推理调用。纳入依据是反馈驱动的可执行组件更新；论文还包含小模型微调实验，不能将整篇概括为权重完全冻结，也不能只凭推理节省断言计入构建成本后的净收益。
items.summary_en: CPU-ARC turns reasoning steps into reusable Python semantic functions. Its builder revises candidates using execution errors, judge feedback, and checks, then registers successful functions in a system-level cache for later inference. The qualifying mechanism is feedback-driven revision of executable components. Separate small-model finetuning experiments mean the whole paper should not be described as weight-frozen, and inference savings alone do not establish net savings after construction costs.

The code-learning branch of AMP lets a manipulation agent revise code and memory in persistent storage using task-success feedback while model weights stay fixed. Reusable Python manipulation functions can be imported by later tasks, providing executable components that persist across tasks. Inclusion is limited to this code-update branch; storing textual experience or using a fixed framework alone does not establish Harness evolution, nor do these results establish generality across arbitrary real robots.
items.summary_zh: AMP 的代码学习分支让操控 Agent 在模型权重固定时，根据任务成功反馈修订持久存储中的代码与记忆。可复用的 Python 操控函数能被后续任务导入调用，形成跨任务保留的可执行组件。这里纳入的是该代码更新分支；仅保存文字经验或使用固定框架，不足以据此认定 Harness 演化，也不能扩大为任意真实机器人上的泛化结论。
items.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies

items.summary_en: BadEvolve examines whether skill-evolving agents can turn poisoned evolution tasks into rules that persist into later behavior, under a threat model that prevents direct modification of victim skills. The evaluated evolvers update skills from execution traces and outcomes, then reuse them on test tasks; clean and trigger-attached tasks are assessed separately. This is Harness-specific security evaluation whose findings are limited to the tested skill-evolution frameworks and threat model, rather than every prompt or memory component.
items.summary_zh: BadEvolve 检验技能自演化系统是否会把受污染的演化任务转成持续影响后续行为的规则，威胁模型不允许攻击者直接修改受害者技能。被测演化器从执行轨迹与任务结果更新技能，并在后续测试任务中复用；实验分别评估普通任务和带触发条件的任务。它属于 Harness 专项安全评测，结论限于所测技能演化框架与威胁模型，不能推广为所有提示或记忆组件都已验证存在同样问题。
items.title: When Experience Becomes a Backdoor: Poisoning Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Failure-Aware Task Optimization

items.short_title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement with Statistical Guarantees
items.summary_en: TRUST organizes admission of Harness candidates as statistical tests across rounds. Historical feedback guides rule or policy revisions, and paired validation outcomes must accumulate sufficient evidence before replacing the incumbent. An LLM allocates testing budget from information available before validation, while test data are used only for reporting. Its guarantees depend on assumptions about bias from reused validation samples and a tolerated loss margin; they control an expected proportion of unacceptable acceptances, not improvement after every accepted update.
items.summary_zh: TRUST 把 Harness 候选的准入组织为跨轮统计检验：依据既往反馈提出规则或策略修改，在成对验证结果积累足够证据时替换当前版本。LLM 根据验证开始前的历史分配检验预算，测试集仅用于报告。其保证依赖验证样本重用的偏差条件及容忍损失设定，控制的是不合格接纳的预期比例，并不保证每次接受都提高表现。
items.title: Trustworthy Recursive Self-Improvement with Statistical Guarantees

items.summary_en: JoMoHa trains an Engineer that generates executable harnesses and a task-solving Solver using task outcomes. Historical feedback conditions code proposals, which are validated before execution. Saved programs and model checkpoints are selected on validation and frozen for evaluation; program swaps at fixed Solver weights examine the contribution of the code. Its coevolution evidence includes retained and reused code artifacts beyond model learning, without establishing continual self-modification at deployment or local reruns of every cited baseline.
items.summary_zh: JoMoHa 用任务执行回报共同训练生成可执行 Harness 的 Engineer 与执行任务的 Solver。Engineer 根据历史反馈提出代码，经验证后运行；保存的程序与模型检查点经验证集选择，再冻结用于评估，固定 Solver 的新旧程序互换用于区分代码贡献。纳入共演化的依据是模型学习之外确有代码工件生成、保留与复用；不能写成部署期持续自改，也不能把引用的全部基线当作同批重跑。
items.title: JoMoHa: Joint Model--Harness Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
EmoHarness: Boosting Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Meta-Harness Evolving
items.summary_zh: EmoHarness让Builder依据冻结学生模型的失败轨迹修改提示、配置和受限验证代码，用独立验证集决定是否替换当前Harness，并将采用版本留给后续改进轮。主要收益来自音频证据，演化增量未通过多重比较校正；人工开发曾查看部分评测项，因此不能将全部评测称为从未触碰的留出集。
items.summary_en: EmoHarness uses a Builder to revise prompts, settings and restricted verification code from a frozen student model’s failure traces. A separate validation split decides whether a candidate replaces the current Harness for later rounds. Most gains come from audio evidence, and the incremental evolution gains do not survive multiple-comparison correction. Human developers inspected some evaluation items, so the evaluation is not an untouched holdout.

The procedural-skill branch of MIRIX AutoDream judges session outcomes from execution transcripts, then uses a curator to create, edit, or delete skill instructions for later agents. Skills acquired on training tasks are frozen and evaluated for reuse on new tasks. Inclusion rests on feedback-driven revision of procedural steps, separate from semantic-record consolidation and factual retrieval. The experiments evaluate the combined process, without isolating the benefit of every skill edit or individual component.
items.summary_zh: MIRIX 的 AutoDream 程序性技能分支根据会话轨迹判断成败，再由 curator 创建、编辑或删除供后续 Agent 使用的技能指令。训练任务形成的技能库冻结后，在新任务上评估复用。纳入依据是反馈驱动的程序性步骤修订，语义记录合并与事实检索不属于这条证据；实验评估的是整套流程，未单独证明每次技能修改或某个组件的收益。
items.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System

items.summary_en: SciMARS uses execution traces and public probes to revise team role procedures, handoff contracts, and, in its memory extension, evidence-recording and retrieval policies before composing and selecting a successor harness. Retained edits govern later improvement rounds of the same task; new evaluation tasks reset adaptation, so this is not cross-task accumulation. The optimizer itself stays fixed. Scientific discovery is evaluated through experimental-data replay and a digital twin, rather than new physical wet-lab experiments.
items.summary_zh: SciMARS 根据执行轨迹和公开探针，分别修订多 Agent 团队的角色程序、交接契约，以及扩展版的记忆读写策略，再组合并选择下一版 Harness。被选修改用于同一任务的后续改进轮，新的评测任务会重置，不能写成跨任务积累；改进器本身保持固定。科学发现评测使用实验数据回放与数字孪生，并非新做实体湿实验。
items.title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery

items.short_title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
items.summary_en: Before task learning, RoboScript segments the collected demonstrations and asks a coding agent to write environment-specific skills for gaps in the existing action interface. An independent driver replays the skills, checks transfer across layouts, and rechecks gains against regressions. Coverage feedback drives further rounds before the skill library is frozen for later tasks. Inclusion is limited to this executable tool-skill construction and selection loop, separate from ordinary Task Memory content updates. The paper does not isolate the contribution of skill construction, and continual failure-driven skill creation during deployment remains future work.
items.summary_zh: RoboScript 在任务学习前把汇集的示范拆为动作片段，将现有接口无法覆盖的缺口交给 coding agent 编写环境技能。独立 driver 回放、检查跨布局复用并复查新增技能的得失，按覆盖反馈迭代后冻结技能库，供后续任务调用。这里仅将可执行工具技能的构建与筛选闭环纳入 Harness；普通 Task Memory 内容更新另计。论文未单独量化技能构建的贡献，部署中遇到失败再持续生成新技能仍是未来工作。
items.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation

items.summary_en: RoboACE alternates revisions to curriculum-selection and execution Harnesses around frozen foundation models. Optimizers inspect independent-run feedback, revise prompts, tool interfaces and procedural skills, and compare versions on fixed task snapshots before retention. The qualifying objects are the selection and execution methods, not the curriculum tasks themselves. Results cover one development trajectory and fixed panels within the LIBERO ecosystem; final evaluation does not select versions.
items.summary_zh: RoboACE在冻结基础模型外，交替修改课程选择与任务执行的Harness。优化器读取独立运行的反馈，修订提示、工具接口和程序技能，再用固定任务快照比较并保留版本；纳入的是选择和执行的方法修改，课程任务本身不计作Harness。结果来自单条开发轨迹及LIBERO生态的固定评测子集，最终评测不参与版本选择。
items.title: RoboACE: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Robot Self-Improvement

items.summary_en: SAT uses a teacher to write reusable procedural skills from student failure traces and diagnostic probes. Positive utility on development tasks governs admission or replacement of generic skills. After the teacher leaves, the fixed student and base executor reuse the library on later tasks. Benefits depend on the student and delivery method. Evaluation covers new instances of task families seen during preparation, not arbitrary domain transfer.
items.summary_zh: SAT教师根据学生的失败轨迹和诊断探测，编写可复用的程序性技能指令；开发任务上的正效用决定技能是否入库或替换通用技能。教师退出后，固定学生与执行框架在后续任务中继续使用技能库。收益依赖学生及技能投递方式，验证范围是准备阶段已见任务族的新实例，不能外推为任意领域迁移。
items.title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents

items.summary_en: NCP studies verified admission and persistence of external control rules. Execution telemetry generates candidates, and a verifier binds evidence to the rule and current policy version before admission or rejection; temporary weight interventions are restored after each request. All candidates were rejected in the actual microbenchmark, leaving the active policy and final outputs unchanged. This is control-layer framework and negative-result evidence; promotion in controlled tests does not establish self-improvement on real tasks.
items.summary_zh: NCP研究外部控制规则的验证准入与持久化：执行遥测生成候选规则，验证器将结果绑定到规则和当前策略版本，再决定采用或拒绝；每次请求结束恢复临时权重干预。真实微基准里所有候选都被拒绝，活动策略和最终结果均未改变。它提供控制层框架及负结果证据，受控测试中的晋升不代表真实任务实现了自我改进。
items.title: NCP: Verifier-Guided Optimization of Weight-Space Control Policies
Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents
items.short_title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight
items.summary_zh: ViCoR 将视觉条件反射实现为可修改的 Python 引导函数，用视觉反馈调整触发规则，并在回合分数改善时保存技能库供后续回合复用。反射负责唤醒快速视觉模型，动作仍由模型决策。
items.summary_en: ViCoR implements visual reflexes as editable Python guide functions, adjusts triggers using visual feedback, and checkpoints the library when episode scores improve for reuse in later episodes. Reflexes wake a fast vision model rather than directly issuing actions.

items.title: The RSI Tax: When Recursive Self-Improvement Is Not Worth the Cost
items.summary_zh: RSI Tax 以先记录任务结果、再更新持久状态的协议评测 Harness 等自改方法，并区分任务执行与改进调用的 token 成本。它记录工件是否在后续使用；该标签不证明准确率收益，也不等于实际账单。
items.summary_en: RSI Tax evaluates Harness and related self-improvement methods by recording task outcomes before updating persistent state, separating task-execution tokens from improvement tokens. It tracks subsequent artifact use, which does not establish an accuracy benefit or an actual monetary bill.

LASER represents observation skills as structured instructions and uses discrepancies between generated and reference captions to revise a responsible field or add a skill. A candidate replaces the library only when it improves caption quality without increasing contradictions on a selection set containing different videos. Later rounds reuse the accepted library. Model parameters stay fixed, and evaluation freezes the library; the evidence concerns video object-state description.
items.summary_zh: LASER把观察技能表示为结构化指令，根据生成描述与参考描述的差异，修订负责的指令字段或增建技能。候选在不同视频组成的选择集上改善描述质量且不增加矛盾时才替换技能库，后续轮次复用；模型参数保持固定，最终评测冻结技能库。证据限定于视频物体状态描述。
items.title: Looking One Step Ahead: An Anticipation-guided Agent for Object State Readout in Videos

items.short_title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
items.summary_en: FGSE turns execution experience into bounded prompt or tool-policy patches with explicit preconditions. It tests temporary changes on transfer, falsification and archived regression probes before committing, narrowing the scope and retrying, or rejecting them. Accepted changes are reused on later tasks and can be removed from retrieval after violations. Inclusion is limited to the explicit prompt/tool-policy branch, not all memory content; theoretical guarantees depend on the stated assumptions.
items.summary_zh: FGSE把执行经验转为带适用前提的有限提示或工具策略补丁，在临时状态下测试迁移、反例和历史回归，再提交、缩小适用范围重试或拒绝。通过的行为修改在后续任务中复用，出现违例可停止检索。这里只收录明确的提示/工具策略修改分支，不把所有记忆内容都算作Harness；理论保证依赖论文所列假设。
items.title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents

items.summary_en: Continual-ARC evaluates persistent agent harnesses on a stream of recurring ARC tasks with fresh instances, using reset controls and frozen seen-task and held-out tests. The tested systems retain programs and skill files across sessions. Persistence alone generally gives limited memorization gains; explicit guidance to write, verify and reuse programs helps on returning tasks, while gains on unseen tasks remain small or absent. This is a harness-focused evaluation, not evidence that feedback-budget comparisons match training and teacher costs.
items.summary_zh: Continual-ARC 用反复出现且实例更新的 ARC 任务流，比较可保留程序和技能文件的 Agent Harness 与清空状态的对照；流结束后冻结系统，分别测试已见任务的新实例和未见任务。论文观察到，持久化本身的记忆收益有限，明确的程序编写、验证与复用指导能改善已见任务表现，而未见任务的泛化收益仍很小或没有。纳入为 Harness 专项评测；反馈预算可比不代表模型训练与教师成本完全匹配。
items.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime

items.summary_en: Execution and validation feedback select solver edits together with instructions for subsequent investigation, retaining accepted instructions for later rounds while the model and executable supervisor stay fixed. Inclusion rests on instruction-policy evolution; the solver is a task artifact. Developers have seen test results, and a better final program does not establish a better improver.
items.summary_zh: 执行与验证反馈共同筛选数值求解器及后续调查指令，并把通过的指令保留到下一轮；模型与可执行监督器固定。纳入依据是指令策略迭代，求解器本身属于任务产物。作者已接触测试结果，最终程序变好不等于改进器变强。
items.title: RSI-PDEbench: A Benchmark for Self-Improving Agents in PDE Solving

items.summary_en: Compiles and retains protocol instructions from failure types in training trajectories, then freezes them for reuse across test questions; a skill library also evolves from feedback. Harness inclusion is limited to the protocol-prompt component. Templates and the execution mechanism stay fixed, retrieved skills are disabled on most datasets, and overall gains cannot all be attributed to hypergraph skill evolution. Counterfactual admission uses model judgments.
items.summary_zh: 根据训练轨迹的失败类型组合并保留协议指令，冻结后在测试问题间复用；技能库另按反馈演化。Harness 纳入限于协议提示组件，模板和执行机制固定，多数数据集关闭检索技能注入，不能把整体收益全归超图技能演化。反事实准入使用模型判断。
items.title: HyperSkill: Training-Free Omnimodal GRPO via Hypergraph-Indexed Skill-Library Evolution

items.summary_en: Uses tool execution and inspection to revise Actor and Evaluator instructions, rubrics and skills, retaining them across improvement rounds; Actor adoption requires support from its own fresh output. Model weights stay fixed. Harnesses and history reset between independent tasks, so cross-task transfer and sustained long-term improvement remain untested.
items.summary_zh: 通过工具执行与核查共同修改 Actor 和 Evaluator 的指令、评判规则及技能，保留到后续改进轮次；Actor 的采纳须由其自身的新输出支持。模型权重固定，独立任务之间重置 Harness 与历史，跨任务迁移及长期持续改进尚未验证。
items.title: Verify by Doing: Co-Evolving Agent Execution and Evaluation without External Feedback

items.summary_en: Human experts iteratively revise diagnostic rules, judge skills and an override gate against prespecified target and control cases, retaining accepted Harness versions and checking a session-disjoint evaluation split. This is a human-guided Harness-improvement evaluation. No automatically generated knowledge change has been approved, merged and re-indexed in the deployed corpus, so it does not establish autonomous production repair.
items.summary_zh: 人工专家按预定目标与控制案例迭代诊断规则、judge 技能和覆盖门，保留通过检查的 Harness 版本，并用按会话分开的评估集检查。属于人工引导的 Harness 改进评测；自动生成的知识变更尚未获批合并到已部署语料并重建索引，不能称生产系统已自主修复。
items.title: AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support
MULTILOOP: Evolving Multi-Agent Harnesses for Complex Information-Seeking Tasks
items.summary_zh: MULTILOOP 依据训练任务成绩和多代理轨迹修改 Harness，保存版本以便回滚并选择训练表现最佳者。实际改动主要集中于提示、工具声明和下载工具；深层编排问题与额外推理成本仍未消除。
items.summary_en: MULTILOOP revises a multi-agent Harness using training-task scores and trajectories, retaining versions for rollback and selecting the best training performer. Observed changes mainly concern prompts, tool declarations, and a download tool; deeper orchestration problems and additional inference costs remain.

items.title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
items.summary_zh: 其中的自改进实验根据运行反馈改写共享 Python 操作与指南并跨任务组复用；未显示明显优于默认配置，且每回合成本更高。最终静态方案的提升与此分开；实验接触被评分任务，各轮任务组不同，每配置仅评测一次。
items.summary_en: A self-improvement experiment revises shared Python operations and a guide from execution feedback and reuses them across task groups. It does not clearly outperform the default and costs more per episode. Gains of the final static system are separate; the improvement runs encounter scored tasks, use different groups across rounds, and evaluate each configuration once.

items.title: Does a Self-Learning Migration Agent Learn? An Audited Evaluation of Evidence-Graded Experience Memory for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration
items.short_title: Does a Self-Learning Migration Agent Learn? An Audited Evaluation of Evidence-Graded Experience Memory for Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Migration
items.summary_zh: 迁移实验中的人工监督循环以预先写定的检查条件和 Oracle 执行结果筛选提示段与 Harness 修复，保留到后续版本；与记忆和策略 ranker 实验分开。同一语料反复参与调试且规模变化，原始工件未公开，不能当作自主改进或独立留出集验证。
items.summary_en: A human-supervised migration study selects prompt paragraphs and Harness fixes using prespecified checks and Oracle execution results, retaining revisions across versions; memory and strategy-ranker experiments are separate. The same corpus is repeatedly used for debugging and changes in size; raw artifacts remain internal, so this is not evidence of autonomous improvement or independent holdout validation.

items.title: Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents
items.short_title: Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents
items.summary_zh: 提出自生成提示、工具和工作流配置的持久准入理论：先冻结候选，再以新鲜审计样本和预定指标决定采纳，并约束相对参考版本的退化。证据来自合成统计实验，尚无真实 Agent 实证；保证受抽样、评估有效性与目标分布假设限制。
items.summary_en: Develops a theory for persistent adoption of generated prompt, tool and workflow configurations: freeze a candidate, audit it with fresh observations and prespecified metrics, and constrain degradation relative to a reference. Evidence comes from synthetic statistical experiments, not a real-agent study; guarantees depend on sampling, evaluation validity and target-distribution assumptions.

items.title: Small Language Models for Inference-Capability Routing: Effects of Model Capacity and Prompt Optimization on Downstream Quality and Efficiency
items.short_title: Small Language Models for Inference-Capability Routing
items.summary_zh: 用反馈优化推理、检索和工具能力的路由指令，再将保留的提示用于后续查询，比较路由质量与下游表现。部分下游数据与前序数据重叠且标签事后修正；所列节省不含路由器开销，两部分测量环境不同，不能当作端到端成本或延迟收益。
items.summary_en: Optimizes capability-routing instructions for reasoning, retrieval and tools from feedback, then reuses the retained prompts on later queries to study routing and downstream behavior. Some downstream data overlap earlier data and labels were revised after analysis. Reported savings omit router overhead and the measurements use different environments, so they are not end-to-end cost or latency gains.

items.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
items.short_title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: SIM 为可执行 Harness 的修改保留问题、代码尝试与反馈历史，帮助继承的 Harness 在新模型或数据集上继续修订。被改写的是任务 Harness；改进器的规划和搜索程序保持固定。
items.summary_en: SIM preserves problem hypotheses, code attempts, and feedback for executable Harness revisions, helping an inherited Harness continue adapting to a new model or dataset. The task Harness changes, while the optimizer’s planning and search procedures remain fixed.

items.title: RoboCoEvo: Expanding Robot Capabilities through Agent-Policy Co-Evolution
items.summary_zh: RoboCoEvo 根据当前机器人策略的失败改写检测器和共享恢复程序，经留出恢复测试后复用，并以成功恢复数据训练策略。程序与策略随后继续迭代，构成仿真中的权重和 Harness 共演化。
items.summary_en: RoboCoEvo rewrites failure detectors and shared recovery programs from the current robot policy’s failures, reuses programs after held-out recovery testing, and trains the policy on successful recoveries. Programs and policy then continue evolving together in simulation.

items.title: SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
items.summary_zh: SAGE-VQA 的程序记忆保存可执行函数，试运行或答后反馈可触发修订，完成的版本供后续问题复用。此处纳入程序工具子链；其评测包含答后记忆更新，并非全程固定记忆库。
items.summary_en: SAGE-VQA stores executable functions in procedural memory, revises them through trial execution or post-answer feedback, and reuses completed versions on later questions. The procedural-tool path is the relevant Harness component; evaluation includes post-answer memory updates rather than a fully frozen memory bank.

RemeshingAgent revises executable pipeline templates and skill instructions from mesh-repair trajectories, replacing the incumbent only after held-out selection improves and testing separately. Its tool-expansion experiment produced no adopted new operator.
items.summary_zh: RemeshingAgent 从网格修复轨迹修改可执行流水线模板和技能指令，只有留出选择集改善才替换当前技能，并另作测试；工具算子扩展实验未产生被采用的新算子。
items.title: RemeshingAgent: An Iterative Agent for Repair-Based Decimation of Generated Building Meshes

items.summary_en: MetaAct synthesizes executable action constraints from successful and failed trajectories, checks false blocks through log replay, and uses counterexamples for revision. Accepted constraints persist in deployment. Compilation and blocking mechanisms remain fixed, and the retirement monitor was inactive in the reported results.
items.summary_zh: MetaAct 从成功与失败轨迹合成可执行动作约束，利用日志回放检查误拦截并将反例用于修订；被接受的约束可持续部署。实验中的编译与拦截机制固定，退役监视器未实际触发。
items.title: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents

items.summary_en: Synapse repairs natural-language skills using execution traces to locate faults and typed patches to rewrite skill source, with a separate validation suite selecting retained versions. Acceptance requires an improved overall pass rate, not preservation of every previously passing case.
items.summary_zh: Synapse 以程序修复方式修改自然语言技能：执行轨迹定位问题，类型化补丁写回技能，再由独立验证集选择保留。接受依据是整体通过率提升，并不保证每个旧样例都不退化。
items.title: Synapse: Optimizing Natural-Language Agent Skills through Program Repair

items.short_title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
items.summary_en: ELITE integrates independently proposed code mechanisms into an executable agent and admits descendants through compilation and execution-protocol checks. The loop uses no downstream task scores, and accepted changes can still fluctuate in performance.
items.summary_zh: ELITE 将并行提出的代码机制整合进可执行代理，并以编译和执行协议检查决定下一代；环内不使用下游任务成绩，已接受修改也可能出现性能波动。
items.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents

items.summary_en: WeVisForensics updates both visual-inspector weights and reusable reporting rules. Rule revisions must improve judgments on held-out recent calls without losing previously correct judgments before publication to subsequent rounds. The visual OCR consistency inspector also trains, while audio tools and the PaddleOCR detector remain fixed.
items.summary_zh: WeVisForensics 同时更新视觉检查器权重和可复用的报告规则；规则修订须在近期留出调用上改善判断并保留既有正确判断，再发布到后续轮次。视觉 OCR 一致性检查器也参与训练；音频工具和 PaddleOCR 检测器保持固定。
items.title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
